content.value: A 3–Φ motor takes 10kva at 0.6 power factor lagging from a source of 220 volts. It is in parallel with a balanced delta load having 16Ω resistance and 12 Ω capacitive reactance in series in each phase. Find total volt-amperes, power, line current and power factor of the combination. Assume the motor to be ‘Y’ connected.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
